.pbp-room-filters select:focus {

.pbp-room-search .rm-list {

}
.quarto-dark .pbp-room-search .rm-list { border-color: #3a3f4b; }
.pbp-room-search .rm-row {

.quarto-dark .pbp-room-search .rm-row { border-bottom-color: #3a3f4b; }
.pbp-room-search .rm-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.pbp-room-search .rm-row:nth-child(odd) { background: rgba(0,0,0,.015); }
.quarto-dark .pbp-room-search .rm-row:nth-child(odd) { background: rgba(255,255,255,.02); }
.pbp-room-search .rm-who { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; min-width: 0; }
.pbp-room-search .rm-name { font-weight: 600; }
.pbp-room-search .rm-npm { font-size: .82rem; opacity: .65; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pbp-room-search .rm-where { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; font-size: .85rem; white-space: nowrap; }
.pbp-room-search .rm-where .rm-room { font-weight: 600; }
.pbp-room-search .rm-empty { text-align: center; opacity: .65; padding: 2.5rem 1rem; border: 1px dashed #e2e8f0; border-radius: var(--pbp-radius, .6rem); }
.quarto-dark .pbp-room-search .rm-empty { border-color: #3a3f4b; }
.pbp-room-search .rm-truncated { text-align: center; font-size: .82rem; opacity: .65; padding: .5rem; }
.pbp-room-search mark { background: rgba(47,95,219,.28); color: inherit; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 1px; }
.quarto-dark .pbp-room-search mark { background: rgba(123,161,255,.4); }
</style>

  const RESULT_LIMIT = 100;

  const isEn = document.documentElement.lang === 'en';
  const T = isEn ? {
    placeholder: 'Type your NPM or name to find your room...',
    allKelas: 'All Classes',
    allSesi: 'All Sessions',
    kelasLabel: 'Class',
    seat: (n) => `Seat ${n}`,
    total: (n) => `${n} students`,
    startHint: 'Start typing your NPM or name, or use the filters above.',
    noResult: 'No results. Check the spelling of your NPM or name.',
    resultCount: n => `${n} result(s) found`,
    truncated: (shown, total) => `Showing ${shown} of ${total} - narrow your search to see a specific result.`,
  } : {
    placeholder: 'Ketik NPM atau nama kamu untuk cari ruangan...',
    allKelas: 'Semua Kelas',
    allSesi: 'Semua Sesi',
    kelasLabel: 'Kelas',
    seat: (n) => `Bangku ${n}`,
    total: (n) => `${n} mahasiswa`,
    startHint: 'Mulai ketik NPM atau nama di kotak pencarian, atau gunakan filter di atas.',
    noResult: 'Tidak ada hasil. Coba periksa ejaan NPM atau nama kamu.',
    resultCount: n => `${n} hasil ditemukan`,
    truncated: (shown, total) => `Menampilkan ${shown} dari ${total} hasil - persempit pencarian untuk melihat hasil tertentu.`,
  };

  const kelasOrder = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'KKI'];

  const searchInput = document.getElementById('roomSearchInput');
  const kelasFilter = document.getElementById('roomKelasFilter');
  const sesiFilter = document.getElementById('roomSesiFilter');
  const results = document.getElementById('roomResults');
  const countLabel = document.getElementById('roomCountLabel');
  const totalLabel = document.getElementById('roomTotalLabel');

  searchInput.placeholder = T.placeholder;
  totalLabel.textContent = T.total(STUDENTS.length);

  const kelasOptAll = document.createElement('option');
  kelasOptAll.value = '';
  kelasOptAll.textContent = T.allKelas;
  kelasFilter.appendChild(kelasOptAll);
  for (const k of kelasOrder.filter(k => STUDENTS.some(s => s.kelas === k))) {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = k;
    opt.textContent = `${T.kelasLabel} ${k}`;
    kelasFilter.appendChild(opt);
  }

  const sesiOptAll = document.createElement('option');
  sesiOptAll.value = '';
  sesiOptAll.textContent = T.allSesi;
  sesiFilter.appendChild(sesiOptAll);
  const sesiSet = [...new Set(STUDENTS.map(s => s.sesi))].sort();
  for (const sesi of sesiSet) {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = sesi;
    opt.textContent = isEn ? sesi.replace('Sesi', 'Session') : sesi;
    sesiFilter.appendChild(opt);
  }

  function escapeHtml(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  }

  function highlight(text, query) {
    text = String(text);
    if (!query) return escapeHtml(text);
    const idx = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase());
    if (idx === -1) return escapeHtml(text);
    return escapeHtml(text.slice(0, idx)) + '<mark>' + escapeHtml(text.slice(idx, idx + query.length)) + '</mark>' + escapeHtml(text.slice(idx + query.length));
  }

  function studentMatches(s, q) {
    if (!q) return true;
    const qLower = q.toLowerCase();
    return s.nama.toLowerCase().includes(qLower) || s.npm.includes(q);
  }

  function render() {
    const q = searchInput.value.trim();
    const kelasVal = kelasFilter.value;
    const sesiVal = sesiFilter.value;

    let filtered = STUDENTS;
    if (kelasVal) filtered = filtered.filter(s => s.kelas === kelasVal);
    if (sesiVal) filtered = filtered.filter(s => s.sesi === sesiVal);
    if (q) filtered = filtered.filter(s => studentMatches(s, q));

    const active = q || kelasVal || sesiVal;
    countLabel.textContent = active ? T.resultCount(filtered.length) : T.startHint;

    if (!active) {
      results.innerHTML = `<div class="rm-empty">${T.startHint}</div>`;
      return;
    }
    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      results.innerHTML = `<div class="rm-empty">${T.noResult}</div>`;
      return;
    }
    const shown = filtered.slice(0, RESULT_LIMIT);

    const rows = shown.map(s => `
      <div class="rm-row">
        <div class="rm-who">
          <span class="rm-name">${highlight(s.nama, q)}</span>
          <span class="rm-npm">${highlight(s.npm, q)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="rm-where">
          <span class="badge text-bg-secondary">${T.kelasLabel} ${escapeHtml(s.kelas)}</span>
          <span class="badge text-bg-primary">${escapeHtml(isEn ? s.sesi.replace('Sesi', 'Session') : s.sesi)}</span>
          <span class="rm-room">${escapeHtml(s.ruangan)}</span>
          <span>&middot; ${escapeHtml(T.seat(s.bangku))}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('');

    const truncatedNote = filtered.length > RESULT_LIMIT
      ? `<div class="rm-truncated">${T.truncated(RESULT_LIMIT, filtered.length)}</div>`
      : '';

    results.innerHTML = `<div class="rm-list">${rows}</div>${truncatedNote}`;
  }

  searchInput.addEventListener('input', render);
  kelasFilter.addEventListener('change', render);
  sesiFilter.addEventListener('change', render);

  render();
})();
</script>
